packageRules.description: Rust (Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock) -- the ~90 tree-sitter-<lang> grammar crates in src/registry.rs, grouped so one PR doesn't become 90

Nix flake inputs (flake.lock). Renovate's nix manager is beta and needs a `nix` binary on the Renovate runner for lock-file updates -- not guaranteed on hosted Renovate; verify PRs actually update flake.lock, not just open with a stale lock.

Docker base images and build tooling actions (this repo's own Dockerfile is FROM scratch with no pinned image today, but docker/dockerfile manager stays enabled for when that changes, and GH Actions docker/* steps are the practical 'docker' surface right now)
